description_en: Retrieves the address pools of a Global Traffic Manager (GTM) instance
description_zh: 通过GTM实例ID获取地址池列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-dns-gtm-instance-address-pools --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPools

parameters.help_en: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en
parameters.help_zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. For more information, see DescribeDnsGtmInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用DescribeDnsGtmInstances (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_8_8.2aea3618RlSR9K)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用DescribeDnsGtmInstances (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

AddrCount.description_en: The number of addresses in the address pool

AddrPoolId.description_en: The ID of the address pool

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the address pool was created

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the address pool was created. This is a UNIX timestamp

LbaStrategy.description_en:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

ALL_RR: Returns all addresses.

RATIO: Returns addresses by weight
LbaStrategy.description_zh:
负载均衡策略

ALL_RR: 返回全部地址
RATIO：按权重返回地址

MonitorConfigId.description_en: The ID of the health check configuration

MonitorStatus.description_en:
The health check status. Valid values:

OPEN: Enabled

CLOSE: Disabled

UNCONFIGURED: Not configured
MonitorStatus.description_zh:
监控状态：

OPEN：开启
CLOSE：关闭
UNCONFIGURED：未配置

Name.description_en: The name of the address pool

Type.description_en:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

IPV4: IPv4 address

IPV6: IPv6 address

DOMAIN: domain name
Type.description_zh:
地址池类型：

IPV4：ipv4地址
IPV6：ipv6地址
DOMAIN：域名

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the address pool was updated

UpdateTimestamp.description_en: The time when the address pool was updated. This is a UNIX timestamp

PageNumber.description_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
